results.scenario: Sibling and intentionally stopped fixture isolation
results.verification: Repeated after every matrix row, including VM reboot

faultInjection: Test-owned wrappers delegate actual Docker/Caddy/restic. Docker stop reserves the previous port on loopback; the listener closes connections to expose stale-upstream 502. A synthetic files symlink rejects capture; SIGKILL after stop leaves an exact journal; Caddy reload fault permits unavailable publication, then fails resume reload. Fault flags are removed before automatic and reboot checks. No host health or manual route repair in timed automatic checks.
redaction: Raw IPs, protected probe credentials, browser connection tokens and provider tokens omitted. Opaque container, release, snapshot, VM and SSH-key IDs are evidence identities.

cleanup.volumesAndBackups: Only VM-local storage; destroyed with VM
cleanup.note: SSH key disappearance was eventually consistent: first immediate list still included key; subsequent list confirmed absence.
cleanup.hetznerCreationAttempt: A temporary issue-owned SSH key was created, VM creation failed at Primary IP quota, then that key was deleted. No existing key or VM was deleted.

fieldConventions.upstreamPort: Caddy reverse_proxy 127.0.0.1:<port>, extracted from the managed route file. before/after/afterRetry/pending/state contain these normalized upstreams alongside actual Docker bindings.
fieldConventions.provenanceTimestamp: Installation snapshot, not run completion. Later row timestamps and cleanup are authoritative for their respective operations.
